title: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Seeking Diagnostic Reasoning with Large Language Models
summary: Recent reasoning-centric Large Language Models (LLMs) have made significant strides, yet they predominantly operate on a passive-inference pattern that assumes complete information. In contrast, real-world clinical intelligence is inherently an iterative investigative process requiring strategic evidence acquisition. To bridge this gap, we formalize medical diagnosis as an Iterative Evidence-Seeking Task. We leverage Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) to elicit intrinsic reasoning within a closed-loop environment, guided by a novel suite of rewards that enforce diagnostic precision and examination consistency. To facilitate this, we introduce the Retrieval-Augmented Generation-based Examination Simulator (RAGES), a high-fidelity clinical oracle that provides realistic, knowledge-grounded follow-up evidence. Empirical results across diverse datasets demonstrate that our framework enables LLMs to transition from passive responders to autonomous assistants. Notably, our model demonstrates comparable performance to larger and reasoning-enhanced baselines, while RAGES proves superior to vanilla LLMs in generating biologically plausible clinical feedback.
tldr: This paper proposes a reinforcement learning framework (RLVR) with a retrieval-augmented examination simulator (RAGES) to enable LLMs to perform iterative evidence-seeking diagnostic reasoning, transforming them from passive responders to autonomous clinical assistants.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习（RLVR）和检索增强检查模拟器（RAGES）的框架，使大语言模型能够进行迭代式证据寻求诊断推理，从而从被动响应者转变为自主临床助手。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
近年来，以推理为中心的大语言模型取得了显著进展，但它们主要遵循一种假设信息完备的被动推理模式。然而，现实世界的临床智能本质上是一个需要策略性证据获取的迭代调查过程。为弥合这一差距，我们将医学诊断形式化为一项迭代证据寻求任务。我们利用基于可验证奖励的强化学习，在闭环环境中激发模型的内在推理能力，并通过一组新型奖励机制来强制确保诊断精确性与检查一致性。为此，我们引入了基于检索增强生成的检查模拟器——一种高保真临床预言机，能够提供基于知识的、合乎现实的后续证据。跨多个数据集的实证结果表明，我们的框架使大语言模型从被动应答者转变为自主助手。值得注意的是，我们的模型在与更大规模及增强推理能力的基线模型对比中展现了相当的性能，同时RAGES在生成具有生物学合理性的临床反馈方面优于普通大语言模型。

title: MedCalc-Pro: Solving Complex Medical Calculations with LLM Agents
summary: Current benchmarks for evaluating large language models (LLMs) in medical calculation are largely based on simplified settings, where each patient case corresponds to a single calculator and the required tool is explicitly specified in the query. However, real clinical scenarios often require multiple calculators for joint evaluation, nested-scale calculation, and fuzzy queries that do not directly specify the target calculator. To this end, we propose a new medical calculation benchmark, MedCalc-Pro, which covers three progressively challenging task settings: single-calculator, multi-calculator, and nested-calculator calculation settings. MedCalc-Pro contains 2,268 real-world clinical cases, covering 77 medical calculators across 14 clinical departments. Meanwhile, to address the limited performance of existing frameworks and methods in complex clinical scenarios, we further propose a more generalizable agent framework that supports multi-tool selection and nested-tool calling, while suppressing parameter error propagation through structured validation and evidence review. We conduct systematic comparisons across open-source, closed-source, and medical-specialized LLMs, and the results show that our framework achieves the best performance across all three task settings. This work provides a new benchmark and method for evaluating and applying LLMs in challenging medical calculation scenarios.
tldr: Proposes MedCalc-Pro, a benchmark for complex medical calculations with LLMs, and a generalizable agent framework for multi-tool selection and nested-tool calling, achieving state-of-the-art performance across three task settings.
tldr_zh: 提出了MedCalc-Pro，一个用于大型语言模型复杂医疗计算的基准测试，以及一个支持多工具选择和嵌套工具调用的通用智能体框架，在三种任务设置中均达到了最佳性能。
summary_zh: 当前用于评估大语言模型（LLMs）在医学计算任务中表现的基准测试主要基于简化设置：每个患者病例对应单一计算器，且查询中明确指定所需工具。然而，真实临床场景往往需要多个计算器联合评估、嵌套尺度计算以及不直接指定目标计算器的模糊查询。为此，我们提出一个新的医学计算基准 MedCalc-Pro，涵盖三种难度递增的任务设置：单计算器、多计算器以及嵌套计算器计算任务。MedCalc-Pro 包含 2,268 个真实临床病例，覆盖 14 个临床科室、77 个医学计算器。同时，为解决现有框架与方法在复杂临床场景中性能有限的问题，我们进一步提出一个更具泛化能力的智能体框架，支持多工具选择与嵌套工具调用，并通过结构化验证与证据审查抑制参数错误传播。我们对开源、闭源及医学专用大语言模型进行了系统比较，结果显示我们的框架在所有三种任务设置下均取得了最佳性能。本工作为在挑战性医学计算场景中评估与应用大语言模型提供了新的基准与方法。

title: Lightweight Polyp Segmentation via a Gain-Aware Prediction-Space Recursive Controller
summary: While lightweight polyp segmentation is highly desirable for low-cost deployment, reported performance gains often stem from upgraded backbone encoders, complex decoders, or heavy refinement branches. Consequently, it remains difficult to isolate whether a lightweight correction mechanism is inherently effective on its own. We address this limitation by formulating refinement as a prediction-space recursive correction task, introducing a recursive controller that operates directly on backbone logits. Under a fixed recursion budget, this controller aggregates discrepancy and uncertainty evidence, updates a compact state tracking recent correction utility, and applies additive residual logit corrections. By design, this correction path remains small, host-portable, and deployment-explicit. Utilizing a unified Kvasir-trained protocol, we evaluate our approach across seven lightweight backbones on Kvasir-SEG and three transfer datasets, measuring segmentation accuracy (Dice/IoU) alongside deployment efficiency (parameters, GMACs, and peak memory). The controller yields consistent improvements in the source domain, achieves competitive performance against both training-side baselines and heavier structural refiners on representative hosts, and delivers selective transfer gains with minimal static overhead. Code is available at https://github.com/tyui99/Gain-Aware-Prediction-Space-Recursive-Controller.
tldr: This paper introduces a lightweight recursive controller for polyp segmentation that operates directly on backbone logits to perform correction in prediction space, achieving consistent improvements across multiple backbones and datasets with minimal overhead.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一种轻量级递归控制器，直接在骨干网络logits上进行预测空间修正，在多个骨干网络和数据集上实现了一致的性能提升，且额外开销极小。
summary_zh: 尽管轻量级息肉分割对于低成本部署极具吸引力，但报告的性能提升往往源于升级的骨干编码器、复杂解码器或繁重的精化分支。因此，很难孤立地判断轻量级校正机制本身是否有效。我们通过将精化定义为预测空间递归校正任务来解决这一局限，引入一个直接作用于骨干网络逻辑值的递归控制器。在固定的递归预算下，该控制器聚合差异与不确定性证据，更新跟踪近期校正效用的紧凑状态，并施加加法残差逻辑校正。通过设计，该校正路径保持小型化、主机可移植且部署明确。利用统一的Kvasir训练协议，我们在七个轻量级骨干网络上对Kvasir-SEG及三个迁移数据集评估了该方法，测量分割精度（Dice/IoU）以及部署效率（参数量、GMACs和峰值内存）。该控制器在源域中带来一致的改进，在代表性主机上相较于训练端基线和更重的结构精化器均达到具有竞争力的性能，并以极小的静态开销实现选择性迁移增益。代码可在https://github.com/tyui99/Gain-Aware-Prediction-Space-Recursive-Controller获取。

title: Harmonic-Aware Transformer for Real-Time Catheter Localization in Interventional Procedures of Magnetic Particle Imaging
summary: Magnetic particle imaging (MPI) enables real-time, radiation-free tracking of magnetic nanoparticle-coated instruments, making it highly suitable for interventional procedures. This study proposes a harmonic-aware transformer framework that directly predicts catheter tip positions from raw MPI voltage signals, eliminating the need for image reconstruction and reducing computational latency. The framework incorporates frequency-domain preprocessing to isolate the 2nd to 8th drive-field harmonics, enhancing the signal-to-noise ratio while preserving motion-relevant features. A transformer architecture with six encoder layers and eight attention heads is employed to learn spatio-temporal dependencies across the three receive axes (x, y, z) for accurate three-dimensional position estimation. The model is trained on simulated MPI signals and evaluated on real in vitro datasets under standard, bending, and heartbeat-like motion conditions. The proposed method achieves sub-millimeter localization accuracy, with a minimum L2 error of 0.103 +/- 0.092 mm and mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 0.039 +/- 0.046 mm, 0.054 +/- 0.049 mm, and 0.060 +/- 0.044 mm along the (x, y, z) axes, respectively, for the bending dataset. Across all datasets, the MAE ranges from 0.165 mm to 0.655 mm, demonstrating consistent performance. The optimized inference achieves a latency of 0.55 ms per frame and a throughput of approximately 1800 frames per second, confirming real-time capability. Compared with conventional MPI-guided approaches relying on image reconstruction, the proposed framework provides improved accuracy, reduced latency, and enhanced robustness under complex motion conditions. These results highlight the potential of harmonic-aware transformer models as efficient and scalable solutions for real-time catheter localization in interventional MPI.
tldr: This paper proposes a harmonic-aware transformer that directly predicts catheter tip positions from raw MPI voltage signals, achieving sub-millimeter accuracy and real-time performance (0.55 ms latency) without image reconstruction, validated on simulated and in vitro datasets under various motion conditions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种谐波感知变压器，直接从原始MPI电压信号预测导管尖端位置，无需图像重建即可实现亚毫米精度和实时性能（0.55毫秒延迟），在模拟和体外数据集以及多种运动条件下得到验证。
summary_zh: 磁粒子成像（MPI）能够实时、无辐射地追踪磁性纳米颗粒标记的器械，使其非常适合介入手术。本研究提出了一种谐波感知变压器框架，可直接从原始MPI电压信号预测导管尖端位置，无需图像重建，从而降低计算延迟。该框架采用频域预处理提取第2至第8次驱动场谐波，在保留运动相关特征的同时提升信噪比。通过包含六个编码器层和八个注意力头的变压器架构，学习三个接收轴（x, y, z）上的时空依赖关系，实现精确的三维位置估计。模型基于模拟MPI信号训练，并在标准、弯曲及类心跳运动条件下的真实体外数据集上评估。所提方法实现了亚毫米级定位精度，在弯曲数据集中最小L2误差为0.103±0.092 mm，沿（x, y, z）轴的平均绝对误差（MAE）分别为0.039±0.046 mm、0.054±0.049 mm和0.060±0.044 mm。在所有数据集上，MAE范围为0.165 mm至0.655 mm，表现出稳定的性能。优化后的推理延迟为每帧0.55 ms，吞吐量约每秒1800帧，证实了其实时能力。与依赖图像重建的传统MPI引导方法相比，所提框架在复杂运动条件下提供了更高的精度、更低的延迟和更强的鲁棒性。这些结果凸显了谐波感知变压器模型作为介入MPI中实时导管定位的高效可扩展方案的潜力。

title: SNR-Adaptive Unified Diffusion for Multi-Task Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Clinical cardiac imaging pipelines currently deploy separate models for each dataset and modality, incurring redundant training costs and precluding knowledge sharing across anatomically related tasks. Consolidating semi-supervised learning, unsupervised domain adaptation, and domain generalisation into one model is therefore a practical necessity, yet naive joint training exposes a fundamental barrier: conflicting label semantics between datasets collapse LA Dice from 90.31\% to 83.38\%, while gradient imbalance across tasks of unequal complexity suppresses the weaker tasks throughout training. We present UniT-Diff, a unified diffusion segmentation framework that resolves these conflicts through three targeted mechanisms. An 11-channel task-specific output space physically partitions label categories, eliminating cross-task gradient sign reversal by construction. SNR-Adaptive Task Conditioning (SATC) scales the task token by the log signal-to-noise ratio of the current diffusion timestep, suppressing domain-specific bias during coarse denoising and restoring full task guidance as the signal clears. Task-Type-Aware Conditional Dropout (TTACD) permanently removes the task token for domain-generalisation inputs, routing them through a shared neutral pathway that draws on cross-dataset cardiac anatomy rather than source-vendor statistics. Under a single parameter set, UniT-Diff surpasses independently trained task-specific baselines on all three benchmarks simultaneously: +0.87\% on LA, +1.77\% on MMWHS, and +0.88\% on MNMS.
tldr: UniT-Diff is a unified diffusion segmentation framework that resolves label conflicts and gradient imbalance across multiple medical image segmentation tasks through SNR-adaptive task conditioning and task-type-aware conditional dropout, achieving improvements over separate baselines on cardiac MRI datasets.
tldr_zh: UniT-Diff是一个统一的扩散分割框架，通过信噪比自适应任务条件化和任务类型感知条件丢弃，解决了多个医学图像分割任务中的标签冲突和梯度不平衡问题，在心脏MRI数据集上优于独立的基线模型。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
当前临床心脏影像处理流程针对每个数据集和模态分别部署独立的模型，导致训练成本重复，并阻碍了解剖相关任务间的知识共享。因此，将半监督学习、无监督域适应和域泛化整合到单一模型中具有实际必要性，但朴素的联合训练暴露了一个根本障碍：数据集间标签语义冲突使左心房Dice系数从90.31%骤降至83.38%，而复杂度不均的任务间梯度失衡则在整个训练过程中抑制了较弱任务。我们提出UniT-Diff，一种统一扩散分割框架，通过三种针对性机制解决上述冲突。一个11通道的任务特定输出空间在物理上分隔了标签类别，从结构上消除了跨任务梯度符号反转。信噪比自适应任务条件（SATC）根据当前扩散时间步的对数信噪比对任务标记进行缩放，在粗去噪阶段抑制域特定偏差，并在信号清晰后恢复完整的任务引导。任务类型感知条件丢弃（TTACD）对域泛化输入永久移除任务标记，使其经由共享的中性路径进行路由，该路径依赖跨数据集的心脏解剖结构而非源厂商统计特征。在单一参数集下，UniT-Diff同时在三个基准任务上超越独立训练的任务特定基线：左心房提升0.87%，MMWHS提升1.77%，MNMS提升0.88%。

title: Amortising Bayesian Experimental Design for Sequential Information Gathering in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit strong reasoning and world-knowledge capabilities, yet often struggle to gather information effectively across the multi-turn interactions required in sequential decision-making settings. We introduce Amortised Sequential Information Gathering (ASIG), a fine-tuning approach that amortises Bayesian Experimental Design (BED) into LLM policies via a multi-turn extension of Group Relative Policy Optimisation with an Expected Information Gain reward. Evaluated on the 20 Questions task, ASIG more than doubles the success rate of the 7B base model and reduces inference cost by over $25\times$ relative to BED-LLM, a competitive inference-time baseline. Applied to MediQ, a medical diagnosis benchmark unseen during training, ASIG improves information-seeking performance at the 7B scale, suggesting that the learned strategies can transfer out of distribution. Our findings show that amortising BED into LLM policies provides an effective and computationally efficient approach to sequential information gathering.
tldr: ASIG fine-tunes LLMs via multi-turn GRPO with an Expected Information Gain reward to amortise Bayesian Experimental Design, achieving a 2x success rate improvement on 20 Questions and transferring to medical diagnosis (MediQ) with minimal cost.
tldr_zh: ASIG 通过多轮 GRPO 和期望信息增益奖励微调大语言模型，将贝叶斯实验设计摊销到策略中，在 20 Questions 任务上成功率提升两倍以上，并迁移至医学诊断（MediQ）领域且计算成本极低。
summary_zh: 大型语言模型（LLMs）展现出强大的推理能力和世界知识，但在序贯决策场景所需的多轮交互中，往往难以有效收集信息。我们提出摊销式序贯信息收集（ASIG），这是一种微调方法，通过基于期望信息增益奖励的组相对策略优化的多轮扩展，将贝叶斯实验设计（BED）摊销到LLM策略中。在20个问题任务上的评估显示，ASIG使7B基础模型的成功率提高了一倍以上，并将推理成本相比BED-LLM（一种具有竞争力的推理时基线）降低了超过25倍。应用于MediQ（一个训练期间未见过的医学诊断基准）时，ASIG在7B规模上提升了信息搜寻性能，表明所学策略能够迁移至分布外场景。我们的研究结果表明，将贝叶斯实验设计摊销到LLM策略中，为序贯信息收集提供了一种高效且计算经济的方法。

title: Strouhal-Aware Model Predictive Control for Efficient Multi-Fin Flapping Locomotion
summary: Efficient flapping propulsion hinges on operating within a narrow Strouhal number window, a principle nature has converged upon for maximum thrust-to-power ratio. We translate this bioinspired empirical rule into real-time control, demonstrating it on an autonomous underwater vehicle driven by four soft fins. The proposed Strouhal-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) enhances a quasi-steady hydrodynamic model with an explicit penalty for Strouhal deviation, solving the resulting nonconvex problem via a two-stage sampling and gradient optimization that runs onboard at 25 Hz. Pool and field trials show that the controller keeps each fin within the optimal Strouhal corridor (0.25-0.35) while precisely tracking commanded forces. This results in a mean reduction in mechanical power of 8.8\% to 32\% throughout the cruising range of 0.1 to 0.3 m/s. The proposed method also allows for a velocity of 0.4 m/s, which is unattainable for a baseline of the conventional inverse model. The results confirm that embedding first-principle flow physics into an MPC objective yields tangible endurance gains without sacrificing agility, offering a generic pathway to energy-aware locomotion in next-generation multifin robots.
tldr: This paper presents a Strouhal-aware Model Predictive Control (MPC) method that embeds a penalty for Strouhal number deviation into the control objective, enabling a multi-fin underwater vehicle with soft fins to operate within the optimal efficiency corridor, achieving 8.8–32% power reduction and access to higher speeds.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种斯特劳哈尔数感知的模型预测控制（MPC）方法，在控制目标中嵌入斯特劳哈尔数偏差惩罚，使多鳍软体水下航行器在最优效率区间内运行，实现8.8–32%的功率降低并达到更高速度。
summary_zh: 高效扑翼推进依赖于在狭窄的斯特劳哈尔数窗口内运行，这是自然界为最大化推力-功率比而趋同的原理。我们将这一仿生经验法则转化为实时控制，并在由四个软鳍驱动的自主水下航行器上进行了验证。所提出的斯特劳哈尔感知模型预测控制（MPC）通过显式引入斯特劳哈尔偏离惩罚项来增强准稳态水动力学模型，并通过两阶段采样与梯度优化求解由此产生的非凸问题，该算法以25 Hz的频率在机载运行。水池及实地试验表明，控制器在精确跟踪指令力的同时，使每个鳍保持在最佳斯特劳哈尔走廊（0.25-0.35）内。这使得在0.1至0.3 m/s的巡航速度范围内，机械功率平均降低8.8%至32%。所提出的方法还实现了0.4 m/s的速度，这是传统逆模型基线无法达到的。结果证实，将第一性原理的流动物理学嵌入MPC目标函数中，可在不牺牲敏捷性的前提下获得显著的续航提升，为下一代多鳍机器人的能量感知运动提供了通用路径。

title: Where do LLMs Fall Short in CBT-Guided Affective Reasoning?
summary: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) provides a structured framework for understanding a user's mental state by examining the interaction between cognitive and behavioral factors. However, out-of-the-box LLMs respond fluently and empathetically, yet collapse into validation & reflection, regardless of what the user actually needs. They know theoretical CBT (scoring up to 96% accuracy on licensing exam questions) but fail to apply it effectively. We explore this gap with a knowledge-guided framework that treats CBT dialogue as controlled affective reasoning: user narratives are decomposed into Beck's Cognitive Conceptualization structure, grounded in clinical SNOMED CT concepts validated via Natural Language Inference, and a Multiple Chain-of-Thought (MCoT) strategy selection between Validation & Reflection, Socratic Questioning, or Alternative Perspectives. To measure whether such guidance actually changes behavior, we introduce the Protocol Leverage Force (F), a behavior-level metric that captures how far an intervention shifts a model away from its default response. Across three open-weight LLMs and 14 RealCBT-derived case studies, evaluated with human experts, valence-arousal trajectories, and linguistic entrainment, F shows that simply introducing protocol definitions via single chain-of-thought prompting fails to change LLM behavior, while MCoT on these definitions guides strategy selection better. Still, the effect stays within 1% (approx. 1.2-1.3%), and all models remain biased toward Validation & Reflection. These results show CBT knowledge alone does not ensure effective application, giving the affective-computing community instrumentation to measure where LLMs fall short.
tldr: This paper investigates why LLMs, despite knowing CBT theory, fail to apply it effectively in therapy dialogues. It introduces a knowledge-guided framework with a Multiple Chain-of-Thought strategy and a novel behavior-level metric (Protocol Leverage Force), finding that protocol definitions alone barely shift LLM behavior away from default validation and reflection responses.
tldr_zh: 本文探讨了为什么LLM尽管了解认知行为疗法（CBT）理论，却在治疗对话中无法有效应用。提出了一个包含多重思维链策略和新型行为级指标（Protocol Leverage Force）的知识引导框架，发现仅靠协议定义几乎无法改变LLM默认的验证与反思行为。
summary_zh: 认知行为疗法（CBT）通过分析认知与行为因素之间的相互作用，为理解用户心理状态提供了结构化框架。然而，现成的大语言模型虽能流畅且共情地回应，却陷入验证与反思的固定模式，无论用户实际需求如何。这些模型掌握理论上的CBT知识（在执业资格考试题目中正确率高达96%），却无法有效应用。我们通过一种知识引导框架来探索这一差距，该框架将CBT对话视为受控的情感推理：用户叙事被分解为贝克认知概念化结构，并基于临床SNOMED CT概念（经自然语言推理验证）进行 grounding，同时采用多重思维链（MCoT）策略在验证与反思、苏格拉底式提问、替代视角之间进行选择。为衡量这种引导是否真正改变行为，我们引入协议杠杆力（F）——一种行为级指标，用于刻画干预措施使模型偏离默认响应的程度。在三个开源大语言模型和14个源自RealCBT的案例研究中，通过人类专家评估、效价-唤醒度轨迹及语言顺应性分析，结果表明：仅通过单链思维提示引入协议定义无法改变大语言模型行为，而基于这些定义的MCoT能更好地引导策略选择。尽管如此，影响幅度仍限制在1%以内（约1.2-1.3%），且所有模型仍偏向验证与反思模式。这些结果表明，仅具备CBT知识并不能确保有效应用，为情感计算领域提供了衡量大语言模型不足之处的工具。
